name: AX-grav-03 GR-SP Pressurised Spoke / Elevator -- modern interior (full)
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

gravity.spin_axis_note: the ring spin axis is perpendicular to the spoke at the hub end (node_top side)
gravity.down_rule: along the spoke toward the ring (Godot -Y); magnitude ~ linear in distance from the hub: 0 at the hub end (y +10.6) -> 0.37 g at the ring end (handoff); the car floor and ladder rungs are perpendicular to 'down'
gravity.note: crew ride standing in the elevator car (2 stations, 1.8 m envelopes) or climb the ladder; zero-g transfer at the hub end

exterior_hide_note: elevator_car, guide_rails and ladder are exterior meshes inside the IML (handoff); the interior rebuilds them (elevator_car_*, guide_rail_*, ladder_*) so hide the exterior ones in the IVA scene

hatch_door_1.note: docking hatch, interior trim opens into the cabin about node_hatch_door_N_hinge (tunnel-local +Y edge)

hatch_door_2.note: docking hatch, interior trim opens into the cabin about node_hatch_door_N_hinge (tunnel-local +Y edge)

elevator_car.note: translates along the spoke axis (Godot +Y) with the exterior elevator_car (hidden for IVA); parked at the ring end in this file

elevator_car_floor_hatch.note: floor trap hatch (0.95 m) hinges up into the car toward CAD -Y for the ring-end exit through node_hatch_1

elevator_car_roof_hatch.note: roof trap hatch (0.95 m) for the hub-end exit / ladder transfer

crew_fit_iml.note: standing: feet / shins rest on the floor, excluded from the minimum
standing: feet / shins rest on the floor, excluded from the minimum

containment.note: signed distance of every tessellated vertex to the handoff IML mesh (inside > 0)

exterior.note: exterior meshes with vertices inside the IML; hidden ones are listed in exterior_hide

reach.note: gravity: crew walk / climb (egress paths); distances are from the station without moving, informational
gravity: crew walk / climb (egress paths); distances are from the station without moving, informational

contents: 16-facet white panel liner over the 21 m tube (bands <= 0.7 m, 8 mm seams), LED inlays every 4th band, 2 orange seam stripes, docking tunnels with liners / trims / round doors + handwheels both ends; rebuilt elevator car (octagonal plan, graphite floor + tread, 0.95 m floor and roof trap hatches, waist guards, alu handrails with orange grip rings, guide shoes, control screen, call buttons, red stop handle, roof LED ring), 2 alu guide rails on graphite brackets, full-length alu ladder (68 rungs) on standoffs, extinguisher, first aid, handrails and task lights on the free +Y wall

lod1.note: lod_b68 v2: blender collapse decimate (ratio R, seam meshes >= 0.30, meshes <= 16 tris kept, parts < 60 mm dropped, bbox guard); same node empties

source_note: site copy of parts/interiors_modern/ax/ax_grav_03/ax_grav_03_interior.nodes.json (build data dropped); glb_interior is the BAKED GLB (props embedded), so no prop instancing is needed; props_baked lists them
